page.layout: One printed page of verse, centred on the left half of the scan; the adjacent right page is a partly visible page edge with fragmentary marginal text (not transcribed as main text). Below the verse: signature line "A.P." and catchword-like line "INSTI-" at right.

main_text.p: Trino salutans portitorem gutture; Gaudentem & ipsum, & lintre plena turgi- dum. Tandem (heu) misertus, strage motus & gravi Gilbertus, ecce, occurrit, & pugnat stilo, Vsum medendi sex libellis edocens. Belle Herclè, temporique! ne Bataviæ Horrenda Pestis vastitudinem inferat. Iam jam dolentem me videre Cerberum, Puto, atque inanem navigare Porthmea. Hic gravia damna, quæ per Heurnij necem Cineresq; Pauli passa pridem Patria est, Pensabit unus, instar Æsculapij. Rependegrates, Patria; ô! quid restitas? Dubitasne, gallum cui sacrare debeas?

page.notes: Right-hand page is largely cut off; its marginal fragments are not transcribed. Catchword "INSTI-" is treated as a catchword at the foot right. Verse lines reproduced as printed; some letters uncertain in the scan, notably "Heurnij" and "Porthmea".
